USE nyc_taxi_gold;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.fact_trips_streaming AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'fact_trips_streaming/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'gold_storage',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS result;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_streaming_activity AS
SELECT
    v.vendor_name,
    f.pickup_location_id,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    AVG(f.fare_amount) AS avg_fare,
    MAX(f.event_timestamp) AS latest_event_time,
    MIN(f.event_timestamp) AS earliest_event_time
FROM dbo.fact_trips_streaming f
LEFT JOIN dbo.dim_vendor v ON f.vendor_key = v.vendor_key
GROUP BY v.vendor_name, f.pickup_location_id;
GO
